about: What testing on real brands has taught the product layer. Each lesson names what broke, the brand trait that exposed it (an id in product/traits, or null), the checks and tests that now fail without its fix, and the reference section that teaches its rule. A detector guard is the pinned detector, run on that component by tools/traits.mjs under the lesson's trait; a starter guard is a check in kit/tools/check-starter.mjs, run on the starter's routes. tests/productlessons.test.mjs holds every entry to the code. references/09-operate.md, After every round, says when to add one.

lessons.broke: The Schedule and TimePicker checks expected the kit's own "9:30 am", so they failed on a brand that writes "9.30am" though the components wrote it correctly.

guards.name: Typing moves the list to the time it reads as, and Enter takes what was typed, written in the locale's way
Every event reads its title and time, and a slot inside a longer event says what continues

lessons.broke: A brand that writes its times its own way had nowhere to say so, so every time on screen read the kit's way.

guards.name: a brand's own way reaches every time: 11am to 10.30pm

lessons.broke: A long page title set in a display face the brand sets in capitals became a line of capitals, which the detector reads as all-caps body text.
A display face the brand only sets in capitals had nowhere to say so, so the product set it in the face's own case.

guards.name: a display face set only in capitals takes them in the title styles, and nowhere else

lessons.broke: A condensed display face fell back to a serif, and the condensed fallback's double-quoted names then closed every style attribute they sat in, so the book's specimen and display steps printed at body size.

guards.name: a condensed face falls back to a condensed sans, a sans to a sans, and anything else to a serif
a condensed display face keeps every style attribute whole in the book, the A4 book and the sheets

lessons.broke: Avatar initials on a dark rail turned white on a pale tint, about 1.2:1, and no gate measured them, because they were drawn content.

guards.name: Initials hold 4.5:1 on their tint, on a rail that turns its text light too, in both themes

lessons.broke: The current rail item and tab-bar place were marked by their fill alone, 1.32:1 on a dark rail.

guards.name: The current page is marked at 3:1 or more, against the rail and against its own fill, in both themes
The current place is marked at 3:1 or more against the bar and the icon's fill, and a grey count's chip edge shows, in both themes

lessons.broke: A pure black rail got a selected row and a hairline nobody could see, and a black primary had no hover or press, because a fixed step of lightness from black rounds back to black.

guards.name: a pure black rail and primary still get a hover, a selected row, a hairline and a press

teaches.heading: 2.1 Tokens, shape, status and the shared states

lessons.broke: A dark navy primary darkened on hover and lightened on press, so one button looked like two.

guards.name: stateOf: one fill's states all move the same way, each further than the last

teaches.heading: 2.1 Tokens, shape, status and the shared states

lessons.broke: A quiet control put on the rail, such as a bell or a footer button, drew in the page's ink, close to invisible on a dark rail.

guards.name: A control put on the rail draws in the rail's colours, so it reads on a dark rail, in both themes

lessons.broke: The phone top bar's actions drew in the page's ink, 1.6:1 on a dark rail, and axe passed them because it reads no icon.

guards.name: An action passed in reads on the bar, on any rail, in both themes

teaches.heading: Phone top bar · to build, not yet proven

lessons.broke: The lockup's product name took the page's strong text on a dark rail, navy on navy, and the rail drew the mark made for light grounds.

guards.name: the rail's tone comes from the tokens, aliases followed

lessons.broke: Focus rings on a dark rail faded in from the page's focus colour, which the rail swallows.

guards.name: Focus is drawn inside the item in rail-focus, in both themes
Focus on the rail is drawn in rail-focus, in both themes
Focus on the bar is drawn in rail-focus, in both themes

lessons.broke: Progress drew its default tone in the brand fill, and a light brand colour reached 2.17:1 on a light track.

guards.name: Every tone's fill holds 3:1 against the track, in both themes

lessons.broke: Badge's check held needs-you and heads-up apart by lightness alone, and failed a highlighter yellow that reads as plainly different from a pale warning tint.

guards.name: Highlight is solid and warning is a tint, so needs you never blurs with heads up, in both themes (2:1 apart or plainly different in colour)

lessons.broke: Skeleton shapes sat at 1.15:1 on a tinted canvas, because they took the hairline colour.

guards.name: The shapes sit a step from their ground in both themes: darker in light, lighter in dark, never a black hole

lessons.broke: A colour the brand keeps off dark grounds still took a dark chart series.

guards.name: a colour the brand bars from dark grounds takes no chart series there, nor does its hue

lessons.broke: A colour kept off the charts still reached avatars, through the tint a name's hash hands out.

guards.name: a tag on a barred hue is kept out of a name's hash in both themes, because a person cannot choose their name
the tags the tokens keep out of a name's hash reach lib/product.ts, where Avatar reads them

lessons.broke: A product named the same as its brand showed the name twice in its lockup and its emails, and a screen reader read it twice.

guards.name: A product named for the brand shows the name once and is named once
A product named for the brand is the mark alone, in the email and its plain text; another product keeps its name

lessons.broke: Checks expected the kit's placeholder names as literals, so they failed on any real brand.

guards.name: The lockup leads, named as ProductLockup names it, then the heading, the body, the action and the footer, in reading order
With href it is one link, named for the brand and the product
It is an image named for the brand, drawn from the artwork and never set in type

lessons.broke: The generated lib/product.ts was typed as const, so its values narrowed to literals and the rail components stopped compiling.

guards.name: the generated file is the kit's own, with the product's values in it, so its types are the ones the components compile against

lessons.broke: Logo's check expected the placeholder's 16px minimum rather than the brand's own.

guards.name: A height under the logo system's minimum is raised to it

lessons.broke: A character pose given as a still was a path from the page root, so every board on the canvas drew a broken image and no gate saw it.

guards.name: a large still is drawn down into the bundle, so a board on the canvas shows it
a still Chrome could not draw down goes in whole, never as a path from the page root a board cannot reach

lessons.broke: A brand's logo files styled their paths through shared class rules, so two renditions drawn side by side painted each other and the wordmark vanished on light grounds.

guards.name: a file keeps its class names to itself, so two renditions side by side keep their colours
the one-ink rendition rewrites colours inside a style block without swallowing the next rule

lessons.broke: Brand logo files carry their clear space inside the viewBox, so a logo sized to 20px drew letters 9px tall.

guards.name: the viewBox is cut to the ink, so clear space inside a brand file does not shrink the letters

lessons.broke: A logo supplied only as a PNG could not be a mark.

guards.name: a PNG logo becomes a mark drawn in a viewBox of its own size; an ink rendition has to stay an SVG

lessons.broke: An email's logo carried the brand export's stylesheet into the body, which mail clients strip.

guards.name: simple class styles become attributes, so a mark carries no stylesheet into an email or a page
Layout tables carry no table meaning, and every style is inline: no stylesheet, no class style, no custom property

teaches.heading: Email kit · to build, not yet proven

lessons.broke: Generated component boards stacked a whole group on one board, up to 20,251px tall, past the canvas's 8000px frame, and nothing said so until the publish.

guards.name: a group too tall for the canvas packs into parts in order, each under the limit, and a giant is reported
validate refuses a frame past 8000px, naming the limit and the board

teaches.heading: What scripts miss, and the checks that cover it

lessons.broke: The gates drew each fluid board once at its frame's width, so every fluid 1440 board scrolled sideways at 390 and 820.

guards.name: a fluid board is drawn at each width it is scanned at, and a fixed one only at its own

lessons.broke: A route that answered 404 was counted detector-clean, because the detector scans nothing there and reports nothing.

guards.name: a route that answers 404 is listed as not scanned rather than counted clean, and the record says so

lessons.broke: The drift check reported the props a component passes straight to its element (placeholder, autocomplete) as drift on every board.

guards.name: a component that passes native props through may take them on a board; one that does not may not

teaches.heading: drift: canvas against system against code

lessons.broke: Refreshing a starter from the kit kept a file the kit had dropped, so the old placeholder page shadowed the worked example's home page.

guards.name: a file the last kit wrote and the new kit lacks goes, unless someone changed it
a starter older than the manifest loses the kit's old placeholder home page, and only that exact file

lessons.broke: A phone board on the canvas is viewed with a mouse, so it drew the kit's mouse sizes where a phone has touch sizes.

guards.name: In the phone layout controls take the touch sizes with a mouse too, and a wide shell keeps the desktop sizes
touch draws what is inside at the touch sizes, with a mouse

lessons.broke: DataTable's phone list joined every column into one unlabelled meta line, so a row with two figures could not tell them apart.

guards.name: At 390px of its own width the rows are a list, and nothing scrolls sideways

lessons.broke: A tag name cut by a single pixel got an ellipsis and no tooltip, so its full name was out of reach.

guards.name: A name cut short shows in full on keyboard focus

lessons.broke: In a dark theme the sixth chart series took the first's colour, so a six-series chart could not tell its first and last apart.

guards.name: six series are six colours in both themes, whatever the brand hue

lessons.broke: DescriptionList dropped an item's value when the item also had a badge.

guards.name: An item with a value and a badge shows both, the value first

lessons.broke: The phone action bar sat outside every landmark, so axe flagged the primary it carried.

guards.name: On a phone the primary moves to the bar at the foot, and nothing that takes focus in main hides behind it (round 3)

lessons.broke: At 200% zoom the sticky toolbar hid the focused row under it.

guards.name: On a screen under 560px tall it stops sticking, and keeps nothing clear for itself
While it sticks, Shift+Tab up the list never leaves the focused row under it

lessons.broke: Delta showed better or worse only in colour outside forced colours, and whether up is good depends on a prop no arrow shows.

guards.name: Better or worse shows as a word in every mode, not only in colour, and is never read twice

lessons.broke: A long book's register stopped at its first few decisions and open questions, and the rows it kept ran under the footer.

guards.name: decisions, open questions and applications run onto as many pages as they need, none cut
long rows are packed by height: no page holds more than the canvas, and the rail counts the rows it shows

lessons.broke: A real brand's book came to 20MB with its images inlined, past the 16MB a published page takes.

guards.name: book --publish writes the deck as a page with every image beside it, and the call that sends them

lessons.broke: The book reversed and flattened a multi-colour logo by CSS filter, so a mark in two inks drew as a blank shape on its own colour and as a blob in one colour.

guards.name: a logo in several inks is never reversed or flattened by filter: it is drawn as supplied, and one colour names the artwork

lessons.broke: The gates' axe pass knew a route only from its --routes flag, so on a round's own routes it never waited for the heading and scanned pages still streaming in.

guards.name: a route listed by its kind alone waits for its h1, and a board is loaded once, never waited on or retried

lessons.broke: A route slow to show its heading was loaded once more, and the slow first load left no trace in the round's record.

guards.name: a route with no h1 after ten seconds is loaded once more before axe runs, and the record keeps that it was slow
a route axe loaded twice for a slow h1 stays in the round and is named in the record, whether it then passed or not

lessons.broke: A form with required fields and no noValidate let the browser's own bubble replace the system's errors, and axe and the detector both passed it.

guards.name: a form with a required or aria-required field and no noValidate fails, naming the form and its fields

lessons.broke: Pickers and comboboxes gave the button that opens their list the same name on every field, so several on one screen read alike.

guards.name: Each clock is named after its field, so two pickers on a page never share a name
Each list button is named after its field, so two Comboboxes on a page never share a name
Each list button is named after its field, so two MultiSelects on a page never share a name

teaches.heading: Date, time and range pickers · to build, not yet proven

lessons.broke: An unread notification was marked by its dot, weight and colour alone, and a brand's dot can sit at 2:1.

guards.name: An unread notification says Unread in visible words, not by the dot, the weight and the colour alone, and a read one does not

teaches.heading: Notification centre · to build, not yet proven

lessons.broke: Leaving Settings threw away a change typed and not yet saved, without asking, and Back lost it too.

guards.name: Leaving Settings with unsaved changes asks first: a link or a command waits, Keep editing keeps the change, Leave drops it, and Back keeps it as a draft that Forward brings back
Saved settings leave freely, and a reload with unsaved changes gets the browser's own prompt, then brings them back as a draft

lessons.broke: A split board's heading set its part number in the display face, which a brand may never set numerals in.

guards.name: a part's heading keeps numerals out of the display face, which a brand may never set them in: the part number sits under it in the body face

lessons.broke: An example wider than its board was clipped at the board's edge, and nothing said so.

guards.name: an example wider than the board is drawn down to fit, layout box and all, and says so; one that fits is left alone

teaches.heading: What scripts miss, and the checks that cover it

lessons.broke: A handler written camelCase on a mounted component, or in lower case on a plain element, did nothing on a board, and validate passed it.

guards.name: validate fails a lowercase or kebab handler on an element, a camelCase one on an x-import, and novalidate, read from the source

lessons.broke: Nothing marked a board interactive, so a published board's mounted controls sat dead on the canvas.

guards.name: a board that mounts a component or wires a handler in its DCLogic is marked interactive from its source, unless its entry says false

lessons.broke: A control inside a bordered group lost the group's 2px of border from its height, so a small field's step buttons drew 38px on touch against a 40px floor.

guards.name: Touch: the step buttons and the field are the control's full height at sm, md and lg, and the group keeps its edge

lessons.broke: Board logic found the bundle by walking window's properties. On the canvas a board's parent frame is another origin, so the walk threw, a menu got no items and the board showed an error there and nowhere a preview or gate runs.

guards.name: validate fails a script that walks window to find a bundle, and passes the namespace named outright

teaches.heading: What scripts miss, and the checks that cover it

lessons.broke: A second brand's product came out with the pilots' look: the radius scale stretched to panes rounder than anything the brand drew, and the kit drew every brand's rail as a floating rounded panel. The brand's own work was mostly square.

guards.name: a measured family sets its role with its source, and nothing derived goes rounder than the largest measured radius
the shell's form: the rail meets the window edge, square, unless the brand draws floating panels
the record lists every shape and shell choice the kit made, not the brand, and says so when there are none
Four layouts by the shell's own width: the full rail at 1440, icons at 1100, a drawer behind a top bar at 820, the phone at 390 (round 1)

lessons.broke: After a shape change the tokens, the canvas and the brand-to-product section moved, but the written system still gave the old radii and an 8px-inset rail, and the drift gate said the system agreed: it never read the docs.

guards.name: a written value beside a token name must be the token's: the docs once kept a radius the tokens had moved on from

teaches.heading: drift: canvas against system against code

lessons.broke: A brand with no symbol showed its full logo, 76px wide at its minimum, in the 72px icons rail; the floating rail's 8px gutter had hidden the overflow, and the edge rail cut it at the window. It also skipped the rail's rendition, so a dark logo vanished on a black rail.

guards.name: Icons only, it is 72px wide: the symbol, a search icon, 40px items and the avatar

lessons.broke: The class merger did not know the system's own radius and shadow names, so `rounded-md rounded-action` kept both and the cascade picked 16px: a segmented control on a 6px brand came out a pill.

guards.name: Its corners are radius-action at every size, and its options sit 2px inside them

teaches.heading: 2.1 Tokens, shape, status and the shared states

lessons.broke: On a black rail against a near-black dark canvas, the rail's one line was 1.06:1 against the page and the phone drawer had none, so in dark the rail had no visible edge.

guards.name: the rail's edge shows against the page: its own line on a light canvas, the page's hairline where rail and canvas sit close

lessons.broke: Sheets stayed 8px in from the window with the pane's corners after the brand's rail moved against the edge, so the window's own panels disagreed with each other.

guards.name: It sits at the shell's inset from the screen's edges with the rail's corners, and the actions stay on screen while the body scrolls

lessons.broke: A quantity field squeezed between its step buttons on a full-width menu at phone width was 22px wide and clipped a three-digit value.

guards.name: The field holds its largest value without clipping, however narrow its row (round 5)

teaches.heading: 2.1 Tokens, shape, status and the shared states

lessons.broke: Every gate passed while a board errored on the canvas: the previews draw a board as the top page through a shim, and the canvas draws it in a cross-origin frame under its own runtime. A harness outside the tool found it.

guards.name: every board must render under the canvas runtime: an error fails the round, and a round that could not run it says why

lessons.broke: Republishing a canvas and a Design System sent every file (166 boards for an 18-file change, 541 for 56), and a live republish put boards a person had moved back where the layout had them. Both were worked around by hand.

guards.name: a board or title a person moved stays where they put it, shifted only by what the layout itself moved
a republish with --live sends the index and only what changed since the last publish, unless --all
a republish against the live index sends what changed since the last staging, drops what went, and the index last

lessons.broke: A brand's live shapes were read by hand from computed styles in a browser, and a first automatic reading took app-store badges and social icons for the brand's buttons.

guards.name: each family takes the radius most of its elements share, with a source naming the count and the rest
measures a real page in the installed Chrome, over the DevTools protocol

lessons.broke: A dialog board drawn over its page went unscanned at every width for two rounds: axe and the reflow check waited for a visible ready mark, and a page whose content is all absolutely placed has no height, so it never counted as visible.

guards.name: axe scans it once it says it is ready
reflow measures it once it says it is ready
a page axe could not scan fails the Accessibility gate, and its line says how many

lessons.broke: The round record had no place for how a review ran or for each finding's evidence, where, owner and class, which the gates reference says a record must hold.

guards.name: each review says how it ran, and each finding where, its evidence, its owner and its class
accepted deviations are listed with their reasons, and what is still open with its owner

lessons.broke: A detector finding a generator caused could not be accepted as a recorded deviation, so the only way past the bar was to change a brand decision.

guards.name: a matching finding leaves the verdict and is listed with its reason; the rest still fail
an entry that matches nothing, or has no reason, is reported, so a stale one does not linger

lessons.broke: A run drew the console in depth and almost nothing of the website, the app or the messages, and passed every gate: coverage was not one.

guards.name: a surface wants a board at each of its widths and a states board for each module, and says what is missing
a surface missing a width or a states board fails the round, and the record lists what is missing by surface

lessons.broke: A product canvas staged under brand/.publish, and its first publish carried no system install, so every board loaded ds/ files the canvas did not have. A texture the boards name was not installed either.

guards.name: a product canvas stages under product/.publish, and refuses to stage boards that load a system it does not install
--system fills the record and installs everything a board loads: tokens, the bundle and the fonts the system ships
--system installs the brand's texture when tokens.css names one, so a board's .brand-texture finds its file
the brand's texture goes beside the fonts, at the path tokens.css names it by

lessons.broke: Measuring a brand's site read one page and no form fields, even on a contact page with a form.

guards.name: across pages each family takes the radius most of all its elements share, and the source shows each page's own
follows the first page's navigation to more pages in one browser, reads fields in a frame of its own site, and names a frame from another

lessons.broke: The Tabs check that the last tab is in view failed once while other Chrome-heavy work ran beside the gates.

guards.name: When the tabs do not fit, the row scrolls sideways and the tab in hand scrolls into view

lessons.broke: The brand's named colours written as a name-to-hex map stopped `product tokens` with a type error, because the reference never said what shape they take.

guards.name: the brand's named colours may be a list of { name, hex } or a { name: hex } map, and nothing else

lessons.broke: On a brand built from guidelines, the starter read brand.json's logo paths from the project root rather than the brand folder, and knew only the logo forge's role names, so it found no logo.

guards.name: brand.json's paths are read from the brand folder, and free-text roles find the master, the dark-ground file and the one ink

lessons.broke: A starter that failed on its inputs left half a kit behind, and the rerun said only "Refreshed".

guards.name: a starter that cannot be made is not started: nothing is written, and the message says so
a fresh starter stopped part way is fresh again next run, so the kit is copied whole rather than "Refreshed"

lessons.broke: The rail's symbol took the full logo's raised height, and a wide mark named as the symbol was drawn about 107px wide in the icons rail's 40px home square.

guards.name: The symbol is drawn at its own size, held to the symbol's minimum, never the full logo's height
Icons only, it is 72px wide: the symbol, a search icon, 40px items and the avatar
a mark much wider than tall is refused as the symbol, so the icons rail shows its Home control

lessons.broke: On a rail in the brand's colour, the quiet words were mixed towards a grey tint, and the detector reported 52 grey-on-colour findings; the only product-side fix was giving up the brand's rail.

guards.name: on a chromatic rail, rail-text and rail-muted are tints of its own hue, never grey, and keep their floors

lessons.broke: A brand's black line drawings disappeared on dark grounds: the character had no dark rendition.

guards.name: A pose drawn in one ink takes the colour of the text around it, in both themes
a pose drawn in one dark ink takes the text colour; a pose in a colour, or in several, keeps its own

lessons.broke: Nothing carried a brand's shape move: a run copied a texture by hand and wrote its own layer for it.

guards.name: a texture move carries its file: tokens.css lays it on a layer multiplied over the element's own colour
the system installs beside the boards with the files tokens.css names: its faces and its texture
the brand's texture move is a class in the components layer, its file in the starter's textures/

lessons.broke: Generated boards asked Google Fonts for weights and italics the display face does not have, while the reference says a system's fonts ship as files.

guards.name: boards ask Google only for the weights each hosted face's styles set, no italics, and nothing when every face ships as a file

lessons.broke: Rerunning the boards rewrote Main with only Foundations and Components, so no authored section (directions, screens, states) could be linked from the contents board.

guards.name: the contents board lists every section the canvas has, the title notes a person wrote included, in canvas order

lessons.broke: MetricCard showed "No data" for a figure written in words, such as "7 of 8".

guards.name: A figure in words shows as written, a number given as text is formatted, and context shows only beside a delta

lessons.broke: Once Main listed every section, a canvas of 13 sections failed the detector: one 4px gap between each link and its note was 13 of the board's 15 spacings. The same board read "Console" six times, because module notes were written "Console · Orders (...)", and "1 components in 1 groups" on a small kit.

guards.name: a contents board of many sections repeats no gap or margin per entry, which the detector reads as monotonous spacing
sections that share a label are named by what their note opens with, and a note in lower case starts with a capital
